_comment: Crane game (UFO catcher, issue #132). One play costs the prize SKU's sell price; a customer plays up to max_plays (patience and money permitting) and stops at the first win; each play wins with 1 / win_one_in; play_seconds is the time per play at the machine. A win takes one prize (named from `prizes`) out of the machine. Fictional plush goods only; no real brand or character; in-game money only. max_per_store caps the machines in one store (phase 2); an emptied machine is announced (refill it). breakdown: a machine breaks after a number of plays since its last repair, drawn per machine and repair from after_plays [min, max] (a hash, no game random stream); a broken machine takes no players until repaired for repair_cost_yen (min 0 turns breakdowns off).
